text_block_list.text:
A mock race on the beach.
Oguri Cap signed up for the 2,000m, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I never expected to see a showdown between these two so soon...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Will the winner be Creek-san or Oguri-san...?
Mmm, I'm so curious~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...?
There are quite a lot of spectators.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~
Maybe everyone's on a break?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wapu, I can't see anything at all!
Sorry, but let me through up front!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri's Trainer!
Mind if I take a seat next to ya?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Could a regular race ever draw a crowd like this?!
Oguri and Creek really are amazing!"

“—Yes, the showdown between Oguri Cap and Super Creek,
both on a rapid rise in skill and fame, has finally arrived!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Well, alright then.
Let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okaaay~.

—And so, both kicked off against the scorching sand
at the exact same time!

First out of the gate was none other
than Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the dust is insane!
Since she's used to dirt, Oguri's so powerful!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Creek is getting pulled further and further behind...! Did that rocket start seal the deal!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya dummy! You should know this too!
Creek only gets stronger from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Oguri-chan is so fast.
But... I can't let myself fall behind, either!

Just as Tamamo Cross predicted,
Super Creek gradually began closing the gap
past the halfway mark...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Guh...!
And at long last—!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Side by side!!
Oguri and Creek are neck and neck!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, this is getting heated!
Coming down the final stretch, who's gonna take it...?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, Creek!!
Give it everything you've got—!!
And the result was—!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
âA dead... heat...

The two slid in at the exact same moment.
In the end, a victor could not be determined here.
However—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I thought I could pass at the end...
Guess I was being naive~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri-chan really is incredible.
Still, that was a wonderful learning experience♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Please run with me...
again, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...If only there were 500 meters left.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.

Oguri Cap stared silently
at Super Creek's retreating figure...
